Minimum time between accelerator transient cues on the same vehicle.
Master playback gate for the complete NTR audio system; leave false until required assets and contexts pass the Phase 3 activation audit.
Short off-state tolerance that prevents a one-frame boost interruption from breaking a full-use session.
Remaining boost fraction considered empty when selecting depletion cues.
Response time for BoostLoop to fade in.
Response time for BoostLoop to fade out.
Fade time used to cancel the driver-only recharge one-shot when boost resumes or charge becomes full.
Minimum missing fraction of the boost tank required before a recharge cue may begin; 0.05 means at least 5 percent missing.
Minimum time between recharge one-shot starts during interrupted recharge sessions.
When true, an unfinished recharge one-shot is faded out as soon as boost reaches full charge.
Vehicle speed where the coast loop reaches its complete configured gain.
Minimum vehicle speed required before the coast loop may become audible while not accelerating.
Enables additional vehicle-audio diagnostic output when true; keep false for normal play and release builds.
Prints concise local ignition prepared/played diagnostics. Leave false in production.
Response time for DriftLoop to follow a rising duration-based drift target.
Response time for DriftLoop to fade after drifting stops.
Fraction of DriftLoopGain used at the start of a drift before the duration ramp builds.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to DriftLoop when the duration ramp is full.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to DriftLoop at drift start.
Shape of the drift buildup; above 1 delays intensity, below 1 makes it build earlier.
Time after drift begins before its duration-based gain and pitch ramp starts.
Continuous drift duration where DriftLoop reaches full configured gain and final pitch multiplier.
Response time used when idle, low-engine, high-engine or coast target gain rises.
Response time used when idle, low-engine, high-engine or coast target gain falls.
Vehicle speed where the high-engine layer starts fading in.
Vehicle speed where the high-engine layer reaches full configured gain and maximum configured pitch multiplier.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to EngineHigh at EngineHighFullSpeedMph.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to EngineHigh when its speed fade begins.
Minimum fraction of EngineLowGain retained at the edges of the low-engine speed range.
Vehicle speed where the low-engine loop reaches its strongest contribution and completes its initial pitch rise.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to EngineLow at EngineLowPeakMph.
Playback-speed multiplier applied to EngineLow at the bottom of its speed response.
Uses the server-owned NTR_ExitCoasting state to play a reduced idle/low-engine/coast mix until authoritative parking; false uses the parked idle mix immediately.
Additional multiplier for EngineLowGain while an exited vehicle is still coasting.
Overall multiplier for the complete exit-coasting mix before the normal external-vehicle and profile master gains apply.
Additional multiplier for the speed-faded IdleGain while an exited vehicle is still coasting.
When true, removes the speed-driven EngineHigh loop after exit so the unloaded car uses only Coast, reduced EngineLow and reduced Idle.
3D distance where an external vehicle's emitter attenuation reaches zero and priority may become silent.
Remaining external gain at ExternalMidDistanceStuds before audio fades to zero at the maximum distance.
Middle control point of the external 3D distance attenuation curve.
3D distance inside which an external vehicle retains full attenuation gain.
Master multiplier for vehicle audio heard by other players through the vehicle's 3D emitter.
Stable vehicle sound-profile folder ID used when a vehicle has no valid resolved or standard audio profile.
Minimum fraction that must be drained continuously for FullBoostSpent to qualify.

Minimum starting boost fraction required for the FullBoostSpent cue; 0.98 means 98 percent.
Vehicle speed where the idle layer reaches its minimum high-speed contribution.
Vehicle speed where the idle layer begins reducing from its configured gain.
Delay after loading is inactive and the local internal vehicle-audio route is stable before ignition plays.
Maximum extra time to let the ignition AudioPlayer prepare before playback; avoids an indefinite wait on a slow or unavailable asset.
Maximum bounded Play requests for one new-vehicle ignition session before it fails safely and releases the engine loops.

Legacy common layer response used only as a fallback if a specific fade-time attribute is missing.

AccelBrakeTiltNotes.value: Positive/negative pitch direction may depend on the live vehicle orientation. If acceleration or braking tilts the wrong way, flip the sign of the matching degrees value.

DriftMiniBoostNotes.value: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.

InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes.value: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.

SlopeHoverNotes.value: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

SpeedSteeringNotes.value: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.

AccelerationTuningNote.value: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.

BoostTuningNote.value: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.

DriftTuningNote.value: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.

HandlingTuningNote.value: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

OrganisedTuningNote.value: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.

TuningNote.value: Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics. Disable Enabled for immediate legacy-force rollback.

AbsoluteTopSpeedSafetyMph_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the final safety ceiling, but only when PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph is also high enough.

AerodynamicDragPerMphSquared_RaisingThis.value: Adds more speed-squared air resistance at high speed.

AerodynamicDragStatExponent_RaisingThisD.value: Makes the vehicle Drag stat influence air resistance more strongly.

BaseForwardAcceleration_RaisingThisDoes.value: Increases forward acceleration across the speed range.

DragReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires a higher Drag stat to reach the neutral air-resistance point.

EngineOutputExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens acceleration differences between weak and powerful engines.

EngineOutputMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the maximum acceleration available to high-power vehicles.

EngineOutputMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the minimum acceleration available to low-power vehicles.

EngineOutputReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more EngineOutput to reach the reference acceleration multiplier.

HighSpeedAccelerationExponent_RaisingThi.value: Makes acceleration fall away more sharply after the power band.

HighSpeedAccelerationFloor_RaisingThisDo.value: Leaves more engine pull available very near top speed.

LaunchAccelerationMultiplier_RaisingThis.value: Makes the initial launch below the ramp speed stronger.

LaunchEngineInfluence_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes engine-power differences more noticeable during launch.

LaunchRampEndMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Extends the softer launch section to a higher speed.

PhysicalTopSpeedAtReferenceMph_RaisingTh.value: Raises the physical top speed of every vehicle around the reference stat.

PhysicalTopSpeedExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens tier speed differences: below-reference vehicles become slower and above-reference vehicles become faster.

PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the normal configurable ceiling for mapped physical top speed.

PhysicalTopSpeedMinMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the lowest physical top speed the curve can produce.

PowerBandStartRatioHigh_RaisingThisDoes.value: Lets high-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.

PowerBandStartRatioLow_RaisingThisDoes.value: Lets low-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.

SoftLimiterStrength_RaisingThisDoes.value: Pushes the vehicle back under its forward or reverse speed limit more strongly.

TopSpeedRawReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Reduces mapped physical speed for the same raw TopSpeed stat.

Description.value: Ground wash under hover cockpits. Inspired by hovercraft dust, podracer ground wash, and low-altitude sci-fi anti-grav effects.

Value.value: Tune Primary/Secondary for dust colour. RateMultiplier and SizeMultiplier control how heavy the ground wash feels.
Cockpits use VFX_HoverDust_FrontLeft/FrontRight/RearLeft/RearRight/Center attachments under CockpitRoot.
Engine modules use VFX_EngineJet_Back. Rotate the attachment so local +Z points out of the jet direction.
Boost modules use VFX_BoostJet_Back. Boost VFX only appears while boost is held.
Stabiliser modules use VFX_StabiliserJet_Left/Right. They turn on while drifting.
Use RateMultiplier/MobileScale/Global MobileParticleScale to reduce cost. VFX are local-only and distance culled.
For rocket-style jets, rotate each VFX attachment so its local Back emission and BeamEnd point directly out of the nozzle. Keep SpreadAngle low for a focused plume.
V25 uses layered Beams as the actual jet shape. If the jet points the wrong way, rotate the VFX attachment or change TemplateBeamEnd direction. HoverDust is still particles.
V26 jet templates use exactly OuterBeam, InnerBeam, and FireCore. Beam flicker is controlled by FlickerAmount and FlickerSpeed in each template Settings folder.
